project_identity.name: Tam's Parties — Alex Method DJ
project_identity.description: Autonomous party DJ on an old Android phone. Plays funky/groovy day-party music through 4 energy phases, watches the dance floor, auto-skips if crowd energy drops.

hardware.audio_out: Bluetooth speaker or AUX to sound system
hardware.camera: Front/back camera — pointed at dance floor

mvp_software_stack.camera_motion: IP Webcam Pro — RTSP stream + motion detection + Tasker integration
mvp_software_stack.automation: Tasker — if no motion for 90-120s during Build/Peak → next track
mvp_software_stack.backend: spotify-api/scripts/ (Python, runs on PC or Raspberry Pi)

energy_phases.name: Warm-Up
energy_phases.vibe: Tribal, organic, percussion, didgeridoo, world music. People arriving.

energy_phases.name: Build
energy_phases.vibe: Funky dancehall, modern reggae, groovy bass. Hips start moving.

energy_phases.name: Peak
energy_phases.vibe: Nasty, funky, high-energy. Dancehall, afro, reggaeton, hip-hop grooves.
sample_tracks: Black Coffee – Turn Me On (feat. Bucie)

energy_phases.name: Wind Down / Sunset
energy_phases.vibe: Deep, melodic, groovy but breathable. Psychedelic. Still danceable.
sample_tracks: Thievery Corporation – The Richest Man in Babylon

commits: 8aec1b9 — Fix cover-art upload: JPEG output, size optimisation, error handling, tests
b81d5b3 — Address review: file-handle leaks, request timeout, Retry-After crash
bugs_fixed: PNG was sent as JPEG — now SVG→PNG (cairosvg)→RGB JPEG (Pillow) end-to-end
256 KB limit measured on raw bytes — now measured on base64-encoded size
_optimize_image quality loop did nothing for PNG — rewritten for JPEG
401 expired token blamed on missing scope — now 401=refresh, 403=scope error
No token refresh — added _refresh_access_token() with retry logic
Fixed temp filename collisions — now uses tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.jpg')
Retry-After HTTP-date string crashed int() — wrapped in try/except (ValueError, TypeError)
PIL Image.open without context manager leaked file handles — fixed with 'with' statement
No retry on 429/5xx — added bounded backoff respecting Retry-After

deprecated_spotify_endpoints: GET /audio-features — deprecated Nov 2024 for new apps (BPM, energy, danceability)
GET /recommendations — deprecated Nov 2024 for new apps
existing_code_inventory.alternative_for_bpm_energy: Use Essentia (local), AcousticBrainz archive, or manual phase tagging

stack_risks.impact: Cannot get BPM/energy/danceability automatically for new apps
stack_risks.mitigation: Manual phase tagging in playlist or use Essentia locally

stack_risks.risk: IP Webcam motion threshold needs tuning per venue
stack_risks.impact: Too sensitive = constant skipping; too dull = no reaction
stack_risks.mitigation: Expose threshold as config param; log skip events

stack_risks.risk: Tasker → Spotify skip only works if Spotify is the active player
stack_risks.impact: If phone locks or Spotify loses focus, automation breaks
stack_risks.mitigation: Set phone to never sleep/lock; use Tasker to keep Spotify foreground

stack_risks.risk: Single old phone is single point of failure
stack_risks.mitigation: Keep a backup device or manual playlist on another device

stack_risks.risk: Spotify 30s preview limit for non-premium search results
Spotify rate limits on queue/skip APIs
stack_risks.impact: Rapid automated skips could get throttled
stack_risks.mitigation: Min 30s between automated skips; respect Retry-After
